description: Ochrana zdrojov a kontrola zakladnej struktury projektu.

hooks.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import runpy,sys; p=next((d/'.codex/hooks/pre_tool_use_guard.py' for d in (Path.cwd(),*Path.cwd().parents) if (d/'.codex/hooks/pre_tool_use_guard.py').is_file()),None); sys.path.insert(0,str(p.parent)) if p else sys.exit('Hook script not found'); runpy.run_path(str(p),run_name='__main__')"
hooks.commandWindows: python -c "from pathlib import Path; import runpy,sys; p=next((d/'.codex/hooks/pre_tool_use_guard.py' for d in (Path.cwd(),*Path.cwd().parents) if (d/'.codex/hooks/pre_tool_use_guard.py').is_file()),None); sys.path.insert(0,str(p.parent)) if p else sys.exit('Hook script not found'); runpy.run_path(str(p),run_name='__main__')"
